profiles: Excluded: unverified snapshot timing; no age/date imputation or customer deletion
timing: Use only official history described as pre-communication; exclusive proxy anchor = midnight after maximum historical day. Not a recovered campaign timestamp.
preprocessing: Native HGB missing-value handling and bins learned on each fitting population only. No external imputation/scaling. Same feature allowlist and raw units for all models; S additionally receives binary treatment.
propensity_status: Assumed constant random assignment, not independently verified
ties: Descending score; ascending SHA256(seed:policy:client_id); ascending client_id. No outcomes or treatment flags in tie priority. Constant ranking is the same fixed random policy.
metric_convention: HT incremental gain G(k/N)=sum_top_k(T*Y/e-(1-T)*Y/(1-e))/N; AUUC=trapezoid integral over contact fraction; unnormalized Qini area=AUUC-G(1)/2. No perfect-curve normalization. Random expectation is x*G(1).
uncertainty: 500 paired treatment-stratified customer bootstrap draws, seed 20261106; fixed fitted models/scores, reselect exact top-k within each draw; 95% percentile intervals. Conditional on models and assumed assignment; no training/assignment-protocol uncertainty or multiplicity adjustment.
selection: Compare incremental value at predeclared 30% budget. Recommend the higher-point-estimate S/T learner only if its paired 95% lower bounds exceed both fixed-random and response rankings; otherwise recommend fixed-random baseline for cautious final evaluation. Report the best exploratory learner regardless, and all budgets. This is a provisional validation recommendation, not a Phase 7 freeze or an economically optimal budget.
cost_sensitivity: Purchase-equivalent hypothetical contact penalties 0, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02 per contacted customer; subtract penalty*contact_fraction from incremental purchase probability. Not currency, observed SMS costs, revenue or ROI.
final_holdout: No label extraction, model loading, prediction, metrics or policy selection on final_test. Membership unchanged. Raw-file hashing and ID-only streaming necessarily traverse source bytes but never parse final-test target values.
